claims.evidence: The 8 group codes are the PRIDE sample protocol groups; each group = 44 raw files (one SCX 2D-LC run of one sample) and one .msf. The heavy reference gets one source name per group run (aliquots of the shared super-SILAC reference; spec rule one source name per run).
Tissue lysate = study sample; SILAC-labelled cell-line lysate spiked in equal proportion = reference.
organism Homo sapiens; LUAD patient tissues and LUAD cell lines.
LUAD tissue (tumour and adjacent normal parts); cell lines are lung adenocarcinoma lines; PRIDE organism part lung (BTO:0000763) -> UBERON:0002048 lung.
No cell type stated for the tissue; cell-line cell type not stated.
Each factor-value combination (EGFR x stage x tumour/normal) has exactly one measured sample (one 44-fraction run per group), so numbering within each group is 1; heavy rows are the pooled reference.
Protocol calls them "sample groups" but does not say whether a group is one patient or a pool, nor how many patients; reference is a mix of three cell-line lysates (names not given).

claims.value: lung adenocarcinoma (T groups, heavy) / normal (N groups)
claims.evidence: T = tumour parts (DOID:3910 lung adenocarcinoma in PRIDE -> MONDO:0005061); N = adjacent normal parts -> PATO:0000461 normal; reference cell lines are LUAD lines.
Tissue extraction protocol; "three locally established LUAD cell lines".
Not stated per patient (country Taiwan only).
No age in the accessible record.

PRIDE description: proteins from the cell lines "were pooled with LUAD tissues from women, never smokers" - a selection criterion covering every proteomic tissue sample, not a cohort summary. Cell-line donor sex not given.
No patient IDs deposited; pool composition unknown.
Same PRIDE sentence ("women, never smokers"); NCIT:C65108 Never Smoker, child of NCIT:C19796 Smoking Status (OLS4 hierarchicalAncestors), not obsolete.

claims.value: EGFR wild type / EGFR mutant (tumour rows) / not available (adjacent-normal and heavy rows)
claims.evidence: Group prefix WT/MT = EGFR wild-type / mutant (PRIDE sample protocol and description) = somatic EGFR status of the tumour; adjacent normal tissue was not genotyped, so not available there. Cell-line EGFR status not given.

claims.value: EGFR wild type / EGFR mutant (all tissue rows) / not applicable (heavy)
claims.evidence: Custom column (spec Extending Templates): the tumour EGFR status of the patient group, carried on both tumour and adjacent-normal rows so that normal rows keep their comparison group (WT-x-N / MT-x-N).

claims.value: early stage / late stage (tissue rows) / not applicable (heavy)
claims.evidence: oncology-metadata column (EFO:0000410). Group code E/L = "different histological stages (early and late)" (PRIDE description). Values match OLS SNOMED:234438000 "Early stage" and SNOMED:236040000 "Late stage" (both not obsolete); the template validator lists NCIT/EFO only (warning level). NCIT Limited Stage / Advanced Stage not used because their definitions do not fit resected tumours. Exact TNM stages not in the accessible record. Patient-level property, so also on the adjacent-normal rows.

claims.value: tumor / normal tissue adjacent to tumor (tissue rows) / not applicable (heavy)
claims.evidence: Group code T = tumour parts, N = adjacent normal parts (PRIDE sample protocol); values are the clinical-metadata template examples for this column.
Not stated in the accessible record.
Restates group code, tumour/normal, EGFR, stage group and cohort criteria, plus the unknown pooling; heavy rows describe the super-SILAC reference.
build default: file stem, shared by both SILAC channels of a run.
MS proteomics.
Each group measured once (one 2D-LC series of 44 fractions).
352 deposited raw files.
File suffix -N = original sNN = SCX salt step N (44 discrete intervals, PRIDE protocol); verified for all 352 raw headers.
Campaign rule 1 (spec README.adoc:27).

claims.value: ms-proteomics v1.2.0, human v1.1.0, clinical-metadata v1.0.0, oncology-metadata v1.0.0
claims.evidence: Human patient tissue cancer study (rule 15/18); cell-lines template not declared (patient tissue rows; reference described via pooled sample/material type). ms-proteomics v1.2.0 per upstream bigbio/sdrf-templates 7da1747 templates.yaml line 150 (latest 1.2.0); the spec submodule nested templates copy is older.
Campaign rule 10.
PRIDE experiment type DDA; raw method top-12 data-dependent MS/MS.
PRIDE "LTQ Orbitrap Elite"; raw header "Orbitrap Elite" in all 352 files. MS:1001910 label Orbitrap Elite ("sometimes referred to as the LTQ Orbitrap Elite").
Digestion with trypsin 100:1 (protocol); PD Enzyme Trypsin (Full), 2 missed cleavages.

Super-SILAC: SILAC-labelled LUAD cell-line lysate combined in equal proportion with each tissue lysate (protocol). PD quantification SILAC 2plex(Arg6, Lys6). Patient tissue cannot be metabolically labelled, so heavy = cell-line reference, light = tissue.
CID in the LTQ; raw: Activation Type CID, ITMS.
Online 2D-LC with SCX first dimension, 44 salt steps.
Normalized collision energy 35% (protocol, raw method).
Sequest HT and Mascot PeptideTolerance 10 ppm in all 8 workflows (the 20 ppm value belongs to the Spectrum Files RC recalibration node, not the search).
Sequest HT and Mascot FragmentTolerance 0.5 Da.
5 mM DTT.
15 mM iodoacetamide.

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Gln->pyro-Glu N-term Q, Acetyl protein N-term, Label:13C(6) K, Label:13C(6) R variable
claims.evidence: PD workflow static/dynamic modifications (identical in all 8 .msf); Label:13C(6) = UNIMOD:188 (+6.020 Da, Arg6/Lys6), MT=Variable per campaign rule 11. UNIMOD accessions checked in OLS4 (not obsolete).
MS/MS scan events ITMS (LTQ linear ion trap).
FTMS scan event o(350.0-2000.0); the PRIDE protocol says m/z 400-2000 (that is the ITMS/global MS mass range in the method); raw scan event used.

claims.value: EGFR wild type / EGFR mutant / not applicable (heavy)
claims.evidence: Study compares EGFR WT vs MT patients (title, description); value = patient-group tumour status, on tumour and normal rows.

claims.value: early stage / late stage / not applicable (heavy)
claims.evidence: Study compares early vs late stage.
Tumour vs adjacent normal parts.

limitations: Publication (PMID 40752010, PMC12419241) full text and supplementary information were not accessible (not in PMC OA subset; PDF routes behind bot checks, not bypassed). Everything below rests on the PRIDE record, the PD .msf workflows and raw headers.

Whether each of the 8 sample groups is a single patient or a pool of several patients, and how many patients it contains, is not stated in the accessible record -> characteristics[pooled sample] and characteristics[individual] = not available; biological replicate 1 per group (one measured sample per factor combination).
Whether the N and T groups of the same EGFR/stage combination come from the same patients (paired) is not stated.

Exact pathological stages behind "early" and "late" are not given -> characteristics[disease staging] = early stage / late stage (SNOMED labels; parse_sdrf may warn because the template lists NCIT/EFO).
Adjacent normal tissue was not EGFR-genotyped: characteristics[genotype] only on tumour rows; the patient-group tumour EGFR status is in custom characteristics/factor value[tumor EGFR status].

Sex = female and smoking status = Never Smoker come from the project-level PRIDE description ("LUAD tissues from women, never smokers"), applied as a selection criterion to every tissue sample; no individual-level sheet exists. Age, ancestry and EGFR mutation types are not available.

The three locally established LUAD cell lines of the super-SILAC reference are not named in the accessible record; their sex, EGFR status and whether one identical mix was used for all 8 groups are not stated. The 8 heavy source names are aliquots of the super-SILAC reference, one per group run.

PRIDE data processing protocol says Proteome Discoverer 1.4 / Mascot; the deposited .msf files were produced by Proteome Discoverer 2.2.0.388 with Sequest HT and Mascot in parallel - the .msf values are used.
PRIDE protocol states full-scan m/z 400-2000; raw FTMS scan event is 350-2000 m/z (raw used).
sdrf-tools check reports Gln->pyro-Glu as hallucinated: false positive (OLS4 UNIMOD:28 label Gln->pyro-Glu, not obsolete; same false positive documented for PXD007931).
The 8 .msf search-result files are not annotated as data files (not raw); nothing else is excluded.
